description: This file contains shell script code for testing repository push operations, hooks, and push options in a Git project. It sets up hooks, configures push options, performs pushes with various options, and verifies the behavior and references in the repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the output with an expected output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a string in the output.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats output and saves expected output for comparison.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output to make it more stable and user-friendly.
